items.title: Hodgkinson and gold medal rivals progress at Europeans
items.summary: Keely Hodgkinson and gold medal rivals Audrey Werro and Femke Broeders-Bol progress to remain on course for a tantalising European 800m showdown.
items.whyItMatters: Running and athletics widen the page beyond match coverage into performance and training stories.

items.title: Cricket could go the football way, feels Rhodes
items.summary: The South Africa great believes players may increasingly choose to shorten their international careers and devote more time to franchise cricket
items.whyItMatters: It adds variety to the sports mix without turning the page into a full sports wire.

items.title: Rangers' Chermiti out for 'significant period' with knee injury
items.summary: Youssef Chermiti faces a long recovery from anterior cruciate ligament damage sustained shortly after Rangers turned down an offer for the striker.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.
